nodes.name: ProblemsPage
nodes.summary: Problems listing page organized into curated coding patterns with search, grid/list toggle, expandable problem lists, difficulty badges, and a sidebar showing global skill sync and recent activity.

nodes.name: ProblemDetailPage
nodes.summary: Individual problem view with split-panel layout: left panel for problem description or AI mentor chat, right panel with Monaco code editor. Supports animation visualization and mentor API integration.

nodes.name: ProfilePage
nodes.summary: User profile page displaying stats, streak calendar, ranking chart, achievements, and problem history. Includes editable profile dialog updating name, bio, social links, languages, skills, and quotes.

nodes.name: SettingsPage
nodes.summary: API settings page for configuring AI provider selection among server, Groq, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and Ollama with conditional form fields for each provider's API keys and configuration.

nodes.name: LeaderboardPage
nodes.summary: Competitive leaderboard with top-3 podium display, countdown timer, and ranked table showing user avatars, followers, points, and rewards with load-more pagination.

nodes.name: LoginPage
nodes.summary: Login form supporting credentials-based email/password sign-in and OAuth via Google or GitHub. Includes loading states, error handling, and links to registration.

nodes.name: RegisterPage
nodes.summary: Registration form with email, username, name, and password confirmation validation. Calls register API on submit with success/error feedback and redirect to login.

nodes.name: AuthErrorPage
nodes.summary: Auth error display component wrapped in React Suspense, reading the error query parameter and providing a link back to login.

nodes.name: AdminPatternsPage
nodes.summary: Admin panel for creating and listing coding patterns with name and description. Protected by ADMIN_EMAILS restriction.

nodes.name: AdminProblemsPage
nodes.summary: Admin panel for creating, listing, and navigating to problem editor. Creates new problems with default stubs for test cases and starter code across four languages.

nodes.name: AdminProblemEditPage
nodes.summary: Full problem editor supporting slug, title, difficulty, publish toggle, Markdown statement and constraints, pattern associations, hints, public/hidden test cases, multi-language starter code, and animation uploads (SVG/Canvas/Lottie) with file upload support.

nodes.name: EmbeddingDebugPage
nodes.summary: Debug UI for testing the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding pipeline with tabs for storing Q&A pairs, generating embeddings, searching with similarity threshold and stage filters, viewing stored entries, and a live log console.

nodes.name: MentorLogPage
nodes.summary: Debug UI with three tabs for monitoring AI mentor interactions: live log (placeholder), session history with expandable messages showing stage/rung/role, and cache DB viewer with cached response inspection. Supports auto-refresh polling.

nodes.name: AnimationPlayer
nodes.summary: Interactive visualization player for DSA algorithm animations supporting SVG rendering and Canvas-based simulation with play/pause/step controls, speed adjustment, progress seeking, array-based interactive inputs, and fullscreen toggle.

nodes.name: Avatar
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Avatar composite component wrapping Radix Avatar primitives with Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarBadge, AvatarGroup, and AvatarGroupCount sub-components.

nodes.name: Badge
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Badge component using class-variance-authority for variant styling (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link) with asChild support via Radix Slot.

nodes.name: Button
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Button component with class-variance-authority variants for style (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and multiple sizes, with asChild support.

nodes.name: Card
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Card composite component with Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, and CardFooter sub-components for structured card layouts.

nodes.name: Dialog
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Dialog composite wrapping Radix Dialog with overlay, portal, header, footer, title, description, and close components. Depends on Button for footer close action.

nodes.name: DropdownMenu
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui DropdownMenu wrapping Radix dropdown-menu primitives with full sub-component set including sub-menus, checkboxes, radio items, labels, separators, and shortcuts.

nodes.name: Form
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Form integration with react-hook-form providing FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, and useFormField hook for accessible form validation.

nodes.name: Input
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Input component styling a native input element with focus, accessibility, and file-upload state support.

nodes.name: Label
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Label component wrapping Radix Label primitive with disabled and peer-disabled state support.

nodes.name: Select
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Select wrapping Radix Select with trigger, content, items, groups, labels, separators, scroll buttons, and value display. Supports popper positioning.

nodes.name: Toaster
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Toaster wrapping Sonner with next-themes integration and custom icons for success, info, warning, error, and loading toast states.

nodes.name: ProgressItem
nodes.summary: Renders a horizontal progress bar with label and percentage value for skill metrics display.

nodes.name: NavLink
nodes.summary: Simple navigation link with active state styling and uppercase tracking for the top navbar.

nodes.name: sendMentorMessage
nodes.summary: Sends a user message to the AI mentor API endpoint, appends to local message history, and handles success/error states for the chat interface.

nodes.name: handleSubmit
nodes.summary: Validates registration form (password match, length checks) then submits to register API with redirect on success.

nodes.name: handleSubmit
nodes.summary: Submits credentials via next-auth signIn with redirect on success or error display on failure.

nodes.name: handleOAuthSignIn
nodes.summary: Initiates OAuth sign-in flow for Google or GitHub provider via next-auth signIn.

nodes.name: fetchMe
nodes.summary: Fetches current user profile data from API endpoint with error handling.

nodes.name: fetchPatterns
nodes.summary: Fetches all patterns from admin API for display in the pattern management list.

nodes.name: fetchProblems
nodes.summary: Fetches all problems from admin API for display in the problem management list.

nodes.name: createProblem
nodes.summary: Creates a new problem via API with default test cases and starter code templates for four languages, then navigates to the editor.

nodes.name: fetchProblem
nodes.summary: Fetches a single problem by ID from admin API and normalizes JSON fields for the editor form.

nodes.name: parseTests
nodes.summary: Parses text blocks separated by --- into structured test case objects with input, expected output, and hidden flag using regex matching.

nodes.name: FileUploadInput
nodes.summary: File upload input component that reads SVG/JSON/JS files directly for small files or uploads to cloud storage for larger files through the animations upload API.

nodes.name: SVGViewer
nodes.summary: Renders SVG animation data with speed control and fullscreen toggle, using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for SVG content.

nodes.name: CanvasSimulation
nodes.summary: Full interactive canvas simulation engine that parses animation code, computes algorithm steps, renders on canvas with grid background, and provides playback controls and interactive array inputs.
